UPDATE public.nocode_object_table SET table_name=#{name},update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updater=(SELECT updater FROM public.nocode_object_version WHERE id=#{versionId}) WHERE object_version_id=#{versionId} AND table_role='MAIN'

INSERT INTO public.nocode_object_version(object_id,version_no,base_version_no,schema_version,state,schema_json,schema_checksum,creator,updater) SELECT v.object_id,v.version_no+1,v.version_no,v.schema_version,'DRAFT',v.schema_json,v.schema_checksum,CAST(#{actor} AS varchar),CAST(#{actor} AS varchar) FROM public.nocode_object_version v JOIN public.nocode_object o ON o.id=v.object_id AND o.latest_version_no=v.version_no WHERE o.id=#{id} AND v.state='PUBLISHED'

INSERT INTO public.nocode_object_table(object_version_id,stable_table_id,table_code,table_name,table_role,parent_stable_table_id,detail_no,config_json,creator,updater) SELECT nv.id,t.stable_table_id,t.table_code,t.table_name,t.table_role,t.parent_stable_table_id,t.detail_no,t.config_json,nv.creator,nv.updater FROM public.nocode_object o JOIN public.nocode_object_version v ON v.object_id=o.id AND v.version_no=o.latest_version_no JOIN public.nocode_object_version nv ON nv.object_id=o.id AND nv.version_no=o.latest_version_no+1 JOIN public.nocode_object_table t ON t.object_version_id=v.id WHERE o.id=#{id}

INSERT INTO public.nocode_field(object_version_id,object_table_id,stable_field_id,field_code,field_name,column_name,data_type,storage_type,length_value,precision_value,scale_value,required_flag,unique_flag,data_classification,default_value_ast,validation_ast,field_state,relation_generated,display_resolver_type,display_resolver_target_id,option_set_json,display_config_json,config_json,creator,updater) SELECT nv.id,nt.id,f.stable_field_id,f.field_code,f.field_name,f.column_name,f.data_type,f.storage_type,f.length_value,f.precision_value,f.scale_value,f.required_flag,f.unique_flag,f.data_classification,f.default_value_ast,f.validation_ast,f.field_state,f.relation_generated,f.display_resolver_type,f.display_resolver_target_id,f.option_set_json,f.display_config_json,f.config_json,nv.creator,nv.updater FROM public.nocode_object o JOIN public.nocode_object_version v ON v.object_id=o.id AND v.version_no=o.latest_version_no JOIN public.nocode_object_version nv ON nv.object_id=o.id AND nv.version_no=o.latest_version_no+1 JOIN public.nocode_field f ON f.object_version_id=v.id JOIN public.nocode_object_table ot ON ot.id=f.object_table_id JOIN public.nocode_object_table nt ON nt.object_version_id=nv.id AND nt.stable_table_id=ot.stable_table_id WHERE o.id=#{id}

INSERT INTO public.nocode_relation(object_version_id,stable_relation_id,relation_code,relation_name,relation_kind,target_object_id,field_stable_id,target_field_stable_id,required_flag,on_delete,source_detail_id,creator,updater) SELECT nv.id,r.stable_relation_id,r.relation_code,r.relation_name,r.relation_kind,r.target_object_id,r.field_stable_id,r.target_field_stable_id,r.required_flag,r.on_delete,r.source_detail_id,nv.creator,nv.updater FROM public.nocode_object o JOIN public.nocode_object_version v ON v.object_id=o.id AND v.version_no=o.latest_version_no JOIN public.nocode_object_version nv ON nv.object_id=o.id AND nv.version_no=o.latest_version_no+1 JOIN public.nocode_relation r ON r.object_version_id=v.id WHERE o.id=#{id} AND r.deleted=0

INSERT INTO public.nocode_index_definition(object_version_id,stable_index_id,index_code,index_name,unique_flag,field_ids_json,parent_scoped,creator,updater) SELECT nv.id,i.stable_index_id,i.index_code,i.index_name,i.unique_flag,i.field_ids_json,i.parent_scoped,nv.creator,nv.updater FROM public.nocode_object o JOIN public.nocode_object_version v ON v.object_id=o.id AND v.version_no=o.latest_version_no JOIN public.nocode_object_version nv ON nv.object_id=o.id AND nv.version_no=o.latest_version_no+1 JOIN public.nocode_index_definition i ON i.object_version_id=v.id WHERE o.id=#{id} AND i.deleted=0

mapper.select: SELECT source_kind,source_key,source_name,target_object_id::text,field_ids_json::text FROM public.nocode_resource_dependency WHERE target_object_id=#{id} AND deleted=0 UNION SELECT 'OBJECT',o.id::text,o.object_name,r.target_object_id::text, CASE WHEN r.target_field_stable_id IS NULL THEN '[]' ELSE jsonb_build_array(r.target_field_stable_id::text)::text END FROM public.nocode_relation r JOIN public.nocode_object_version v ON v.id=r.object_version_id JOIN public.nocode_object o ON o.id=v.object_id WHERE r.target_object_id=#{id} AND r.deleted=0 AND o.deleted=0 AND v.version_no IN(o.latest_version_no,o.current_published_version_no)

INSERT INTO public.nocode_relation(object_version_id,stable_relation_id,relation_code,relation_name,relation_kind,target_object_id,field_stable_id,target_field_stable_id,required_flag,on_delete,source_detail_id,creator,updater) VALUES(#{versionId},CAST(#{r.id} AS bigint),#{r.code},#{r.name},#{r.kind},CAST(#{r.targetObjectId} AS bigint),CAST(#{r.fieldId} AS bigint),CAST(#{r.targetFieldId} AS bigint),#{r.required},#{r.onDelete},CAST(#{r.sourceDetailId} AS bigint),(SELECT updater FROM public.nocode_object_version WHERE id=#{versionId}),(SELECT updater FROM public.nocode_object_version WHERE id=#{versionId}))

DELETE FROM public.nocode_index_definition WHERE object_version_id=#{versionId} AND index_code=#{code} AND stable_index_id<>CAST(#{id} AS bigint) AND deleted=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.nocode_object_version v WHERE v.id=#{versionId} AND v.state='DRAFT' AND v.deleted=0)
mapper.update: UPDATE public.nocode_index_definition SET deleted=1,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updater=(SELECT updater FROM public.nocode_object_version WHERE id=#{versionId}) WHERE object_version_id=#{versionId} AND deleted=0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.nocode_index_definition(object_version_id,stable_index_id,index_code,index_name,unique_flag,field_ids_json,parent_scoped,creator,updater) VALUES(#{versionId},CAST(#{i.id} AS bigint),#{i.code},#{i.name},#{i.unique},CAST(#{fields} AS jsonb),coalesce(#{i.parentScoped},false),(SELECT updater FROM public.nocode_object_version WHERE id=#{versionId}),(SELECT updater FROM public.nocode_object_version WHERE id=#{versionId})) ON CONFLICT(object_version_id,stable_index_id) DO UPDATE SET index_code=excluded.index_code,index_name=excluded.index_name, unique_flag=excluded.unique_flag,field_ids_json=excluded.field_ids_json,parent_scoped=excluded.parent_scoped,deleted=0,updater=excluded.updater,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO public.nocode_resource_dependency(source_kind,source_key,source_name,target_object_id,field_ids_json,creator,updater) VALUES(#{d.sourceKind},#{d.sourceKey},#{d.sourceName},CAST(#{d.targetObjectId} AS bigint),CAST(#{fields} AS jsonb),#{actor},#{actor}) ON CONFLICT(source_kind,source_key,target_object_id) DO UPDATE SET source_name=excluded.source_name,field_ids_json=excluded.field_ids_json,deleted=0,updater=excluded.updater,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
